title: WATCH: Suryakumar Yadav Enjoying Mutton At Friend’s House in Kolkata Amid 2026 Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy

 Suryakumar Yadav has earned praise from the fans as he has been seen to be enjoying mutton at his friend’s house in Kolkata as he is currently in the eastern city to play the 2026 Syed Mustaq Ali Trophy match against Hyderabad.
 by Chetan Phore | Nov 15, 2026 | 2 mins read SKY enjoying mutton at his friend's house · Credits: Via X Cricket Former Indian T20I skipper Suryakumar Yadav who has always been known for his humble, kind and down to earth nature is currently in Kolkata to play the 2026 Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy (SMAT) against Hyderabad. Today, a video of Suryakumar has surfaced on social media platform X where is seen eating mutton with his fellow people at his friend’s house. The video has earned a lot of praise from fans on the online platform.
 “Here, our Manik Bhai is sitting. He has made mutton for every one of us today. Dada here is making the dough with the flour. Over there in the oven, great and hot roti (bread) are being made. JTC. JTC by Manik Bhai. He has made food for all of us very well,” SKY said while eating in the video.
 A BEAUTIFUL VIDEO ❤️
Suryakumar Yadav enjoying the food at his friend's home during SMAT. https://t.co/9Cic6buF5V
— Johns. (@CricCrazyJohns) November 15, 2026 
 “Totally home made food. The Desi (Indian) way. It gives an absolutely homely feeling. I like this way only. Such a great food that he has made that we don't feel like talking but only eating. Thank you Dada. Khub bhalo (very good),” he added.
 Suryakumar scored a 15 ball half century yesterday , on the 14th of November, 2026 in the 2026 SMAT against Hyderabad at the Jadavpur University Campus 2nd Ground in Kolkata. He ended his innings at an unbeaten 60 off 21 deliveries. He marked his return to competitive cricket in his own classy way and that too in front of the national selector SS Das who was present in the stands. Mumbai won the game by 7 wickets as Mumbai easily chased down the target of 173 in just 13.1 overs with SKY and Musheer Khan leading the run chase.
 SKY’s Humble Nature
 Suryakumar Yadav earlier stated that he still carries his own kitbag to the ground as his father taught him never to expect special treatment from anyone and to stay independent.
 As he kept grinding through in domestic cricket before his debut national call in 2021, he has always been connected to his roots for which he never denies call ups from Mumbai clubs for local tournaments.
 He always prefers to have lunch in the mess of Mumbai Cricket Association or by sitting on the floor to have home style meals alongside his teammates.
 SKY has credited his wife Devisha Shetty for keeping him humble all the time, even through his highs or lows and also teaching him to live his cricket life outside the door.
 He has always sacrificed his batting sports for fellow young teammates during his international career.
 SKY has always credited the support staff and non playing squad members after every major title victory, significantly after the 2025 Asia Cup triumph.
 He has helped ground staff in cleaning the covers and outfield post rainfall.
 He always pauses for fans to complete their wishes such as taking selfies, videos or autographs.
 He has also been seen to be providing financial help and respectful greetings to street musicians, ascetics, and people in need without seeking publicity.
